description: This file contains shell script functions and notes related to upgrading firmware on Buffalo devices with MT7622 chip, focusing on handling TRX + UBI formatted images, validation of images, and U-Boot behaviors.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image file for the Buffalo device, checking for proper format, tar archive validity, image size, and compatibility with the device's partitions.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by erasing the current firmware partition and writing the new TRX + UBI formatted image.
